messages:
Priyanka (PM): Heads-up: customer Y asked for a clear launch gating checklist for observability — they need per-route cost, embed breakdowns, and error-slice visibility before enabling production routing.
Mike (eng-runtime): We'll add tracing hooks for cache misses and a per-request cost header. Prefer to emit an estimate first, then backfill real GPU time.
Sasha (eng-sre): Ops ask: define canary SLOs + an alert playbook. Suggest p99 < 300ms, error-rate delta < 3x for 5m.
Ana (design): UX: landing pane with top N routes by cost, a cost-delta ribbon, and a compact error-slice list. I'll share a compact mock tomorrow.
Tim (eng-platform): Note: header requires event schema v3. Plan: schema migration with 7-day compat window. Phase deploy: header (fast) -> pipeline enrichment (later).
Eva (customer-success): Customer Y insists embed calls shown separately and PII scrubbed from traces. Legal wants redaction checklist.
Priyanka (PM): Owners: Mike -> hooks; Tim -> header + schema; Ana -> mock + copy; Sasha -> SLOs/runbook; Eva -> CS/legal signoff.
Mike (eng-runtime): Sampling plan: p=0.01 default, always capture on errors. We'll emit cache-miss metric counts too.
Sasha (eng-sre): Also add short anomaly detector for canary: alert if error-rate > 5x baseline for 2m.
Priyanka (PM): Draft launch gates: 1) Dashboard MVP with per-route + embeddings cost; 2) Tracing hooks live with sampling; 3) Canary meets SLOs for 48h; 4) CS/legal signoff on PII handling.
Tim (eng-platform): Rollout: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto rollback on SLO breach. Flags: obs_canary_pct, obs_cost_mode.
Priyanka (PM): Timeline: customer wants minimal launch in 3 weeks. Sounds feasible if we phase.
Mike (eng-runtime): Agree. Week1 hooks, week2 header + schema, week3 dashboard + canary. Need a follow-up sprint for polish.
Priyanka (PM): Next: Mike/Tim sync now, Ana drop mock by EOD, Sasha draft SLO doc, Eva confirm customer routes. I'll write the acceptance checklist once mocks are in.
